status_html: Research preview · figures to 31 August 2026, updated 19 October 2026. Compiled with AI assistance from public sources and not yet checked line by line against them by a person: treat the figures as unverified estimates. Every number has a likely range and sources; gaps are filled with estimates, never left at zero. Every choice and its evidence: decisions. Method and data: GitHub. Corrections: Reddit or a GitHub issue.
